annotations.title: Is there new HIGH-importance news on a keyword in the last N hours?

description:
Is there new HIGH-importance news on a keyword in the last N hours?. Checks only importance=high news matching q in the last N hours (1-168, default 6): has_new, count and the latest item. Cheap poll for market-moving alerts on a topic/ticker.

GET /news/alerts/new — price $0.005 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

hours.description: Look-back window in hours (default 6, clamped to 1-168) Default: 6.

q.description: Keywords (case-insensitive). Several words = all must match. Hashtags match with or without '#', e.g. 'oil', '#Fed rates'.

name: check_new_high_alert
title: Is there new HIGH-importance news on a keyword in the last N hours?
